prompt: A cleric in white-and-gold robes kneels beside a wounded soldier sprawled on the ground in dented steel plate, her hands extended over his bleeding chest wound as a stream of warm white-gold healing radiance pours from her palms and the gash visibly knits shut, the soldier's face slack with relief. The only source of light in the scene is the soft golden healing glow from her hands. The background is a dim battlefield at dusk, trampled mud and broken spears.

A wounded warrior in tattered chainmail kneels alone, head tilted up and eyes closed in relief, bathed from above in a single brilliant shaft of warm white-gold holy light, the crepuscular ray striking his bloodied shoulder where the wound is glowing and closing over. The only source of light in the scene is that descending golden beam. The background is the dark interior of a ruined stone chapel, broken arches in deep shadow.

A radiant angelic figure made of white-gold light hovers in the air, wings spread, one hand outstretched downward pouring a beam of warm healing radiance onto a collapsed wounded peasant lying on the ground below, the peasant's body softly glowing as life returns. The only source of light is the angel's golden glow, haloing both figures. The background is a darkened village square at night, both figures fully visible.
